evidence.name: Screen field: List or grid layout
evidence.userNeed: Know what "List or grid layout" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: List or grid layout
sections.description: Choose whether choices stack in a single-column list or sit in a two-column grid. Use a list for text-heavy answers that need a full line each; use a grid when items have images or icons and you want a compact, visual picker. Switching to a grid unlocks the image, text, and checkbox layout controls. Default to a single-column list for plain answer choices.
